'''Guy Hirsch''' (20 September 1915 – 4 August 1993)<ref>{{Cite journal | doi = 10.1006/hmat.1995.1029 | title = In Memoriam Guy Hirsch (1915–1993) | journal = [[Historia Mathematica]] | volume = 22 | pages = 345–346 | year = 1995 | doi-access = free }}</ref> was a [[Belgium|Belgian]] [[mathematician]] and philosopher of mathematics, who worked on [[algebraic topology]] and [[epistemology]] of mathematics.

He became a member of the [[Royal Flemish Academy of Belgium for Science and the Arts]] in 1973.

He is known for the [[Leray–Hirsch theorem]], a basic result on the algebraic topology of [[fiber bundle]]s that he proved independently of [[Jean Leray]] in the late 1940s.
